title: linear.v1 weights
description: Gym-cli LinearPolicyAi pack (not Hall). Score is bias + dot(W, concat(packed[128], bagHash[bagHashDim], actionFeat[24])). Greedy argmax over legal actions. Zeros W is a legal stub and is not a trained champ. Do not distill W from YodaBot/AdvancedAi. Training loop is not this file.

actionFeatDim.description: 0 pass, 1 integerNorm, 2 indexNorm, 3-18 text hash, 19-22 blueprint hash, 23 ones. Matches com.gempukku.swccgo.ai.models.LinearPolicyAi.

W.description: Length must be packedDim + bagHashDim + actionFeatDim (152 when bagHashDim is 0, 168 when bagHashDim is 16).
